profile.headline: Software Engineer - New York Post
profile.summary:
Greetings, my name is Michael Diaz and I'm an experienced software engineer passionate about blending music and entertainment to technology. Being professionally skilled in Python, Typescript, Java, and Spring Boot, as well as having developed a profusion of leadership and business skills from prior positions, I offer high end back-end development and strong team relations in any positions I am place in.

As of right now, I am trying to branch out to the entertainment/music industry in tech. I played and taught music for 15 years. Now I am attempting to help musicians, audiophiles, and music lovers express their art through easy technology mediums. Working in music streaming services or companies that create digital audio workstations are ideal for my passion in combining both music and in technology.

Always looking to meet new people and also feel free to message me!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Spearheaded projects at VidMob that secured a significant Series D investment from Shamrock, fueling unprecedented company growth.
• Boosted media frame extraction performance by 10% using Python and NoSQL techniques.
• Crafted REST API endpoints in Typescript's Nest JS applying SOLID principles, bolstering ad integrations
• Employed AWS tools, including SQS, Lambda, and CloudFormation, for advanced reporting.
• Improved data science model performance by 90% via Typescript and MySQL integrations.
• Pioneered advancements in reporting and text detection leveraging AWS, Python, and MySQL, achieving a 15% speed enhancement.

positions.title: Team Lead - Media Processing
positions.description:
•  Successfully drove a team of five engineers to deliver groundbreaking media annotation features, securing a highly lucrative $1.2M deal.
•  Collaborated with cross-functional teams for feature integration and user experience enhancement.
•  Mentored junior engineers, achieving 75% reduction in turnover.
•  Exposure to the Kanban Agile method for team management and task organization with an emphasis on the Jira Platform.
positions.insights: Git, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +11 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed an automated program in Spring to implement financial instruments to Morgan Stanley’s ETRADE House and Regulatory Policies.
• Incorporated Python scripts and SQL queries to analyze big data for new financial strategies and puppet margin accounts in order to test ETRADE policies.
• Exposure to the Kanban Agile method for team management and task organization with an emphasis on the Jira Platform.
• Optimized and Refactored Morgan Stanley’s calculator management repository in Java 8, which increase margin account reading/parsing in Spring by 7%.

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description:
•    Worked in an Agile environment to design a Spring Boot web application that serves as an automated system for con- sultant management.
•    Implemented Java and SQL code to use Oracle SQL as the database for the system. 
•    Utilized HTML, CSS, JS, and React to create and design the user interface and user experience for the system.
•    Engineered and tested a RESTFul API with Postman and Spring Boot for optimization and rapid data analysis.
•    Enhanced productivity for consultant management at FDM by 10% based on distribution of work hours as a result of the new system

honors.title: Best "Use of Verizon API" Award
honors.description: Developed the front end of an award winning smart home application using Java FX at HackRU 2017.
